race.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
race.verdict: SILENT STRIKE got his career firmly back having been gelded during his 4-month absence when staying on late for third over C&D 5 weeks ago and, with that form worthy of viewing positively, certainly in relation to those in the frame, he could be worth chancing to build on that. Another Abbot , Dandana and Bolo Neighs head up the dangers in a good quality heat. SILENT STRIKE (IRE) ANOTHER ABBOT (IRE) DANDANA
race.bettingForecast: Dandana (7/2), Silent Strike (4/1), Bolo Neighs (5/1), Desert Falcon (8/1), Another Abbot (8/1), Purosangue (8/1), Yes I'm Mali (10/1), Harry Three (12/1), Alfa Kellenic (14/1), One And Gone (20/1)
